budget_policy: maximum 16 records, 32 mentions, 12000 full-request estimated input tokens, and 4500 estimated output tokens; live Provider prompt/schema overhead is included
repair_policy: retry only records without safe full-record coverage; maximum attempts are configured and counted against the run call budget
fallback_policy: deterministic keep_unresolved plus completed_with_warnings batch status
scope_boundary: Calibration uses one historical local Run and automated regressions. No conversational continuation state, stable-memory retrieval, final historical sweep, or new paid Provider run in this increment.
